mechanism: Rasagiline is a selective irreversible MAO-B inhibitor that can potentiate dopaminergic and monoaminergic effects, while deutetrabenazine is a VMAT2 inhibitor; combined use risks excessive dopamine depletion in some pathways and potential sympathomimetic crisis or hypertensive episodes.
action: Use caution and monitor blood pressure closely; consider dose adjustments or alternative agents; avoid concurrent use in patients with uncontrolled hypertension or recent sympathomimetic use.
